# Terms and third-party components

The integration files in this repository carry the accompanying MIT license.
The core runtime is distributed separately as compiled artifacts; this repository
does not publish its source or change the licensing of existing core code.
Runtime distribution terms and third-party notices must accompany its release.

Public runtime releases require the owner's confirmation that the tldraw license
covers the bundled renderer supplied to end users. Private build candidates are
not permission to redistribute the renderer. The integration's MIT license does not
grant a tldraw production or redistribution license. Dependencies retain their
original licenses and the binary includes their applicable notices.

The initial preview uses a production trial of tldraw that expires on
26 December 2026. Continued renderer use after the trial requires a renewed license
and an updated TensorViz runtime. Downloaded versions retain their embedded key;
renewal does not retroactively update old installations.

Your coding client, model provider, downloaded packages and model repositories
have their own terms. Capturing runs selected model code locally. A graph records
one selected execution or an explicitly identified source preview; it does not
guarantee model correctness or behavior for other inputs.
